# Tripwire

> A paper-only research and decision tool for Indian listed companies. It shows which public rules fired at the last close, the evidence for and against a name, and keeps the reader's own notes and review dates in their own browser. It is not investment advice and places no orders.

Tripwire is a single-page web app. Pages are addressed with a hash, for example https://tripwire.askakshay.com/#/today. Prices come from Yahoo Finance and every figure carries its own date.

## Pages

- [Today](https://tripwire.askakshay.com/#/today): the market read, the last close's dated rule picks, the paper book and its live profit and loss.
- [Markets](https://tripwire.askakshay.com/#/markets): the Nifty, Bank Nifty and VIX with day ranges, breadth, the trend map, sectors and commodities.
- [Discover](https://tripwire.askakshay.com/#/discover): a screen of roughly a thousand NSE companies with filters on price, trend, momentum and fundamentals.
- [My Desk](https://tripwire.askakshay.com/#/desk): the reader's own follows, theses, paper plans and saved comparisons, held in their browser only.
- [News](https://tripwire.askakshay.com/#/news): market and company news from public feeds, each story with its source and publication time.
- [Signals](https://tripwire.askakshay.com/#/signals): how each rule has performed in a back-test and forward, including the results that did not support it.
- [Data](https://tripwire.askakshay.com/#/data): how current each dataset is, and the eligibility rule versions.
- [Methodology](https://tripwire.askakshay.com/#/methodology): how the screen and the published rules work.
- [Help](https://tripwire.askakshay.com/#/help): the research workflow and what each page is for.

## Policies

- [Privacy](https://tripwire.askakshay.com/#/privacy): what stays on the device and which public sources the server asks.
- [Terms](https://tripwire.askakshay.com/#/terms): the paper-only, not-advice terms.

## Limits you should state if you summarise this site

- Prices come from Yahoo Finance and can lag the exchange; every figure says its date.
- The back-test found no supported edge for the momentum rule. Nothing here predicts prices.
- Paper money only. Nothing on the site is a recommendation.

## Machine access

- Tools registered through WebMCP (where the browser supports it): search_companies, open_company, market_status. All are read-only or navigation.
- A discovery manifest is published at https://tripwire.askakshay.com/.well-known/ard.json; it lists an agent skill, [how to use Tripwire](https://tripwire.askakshay.com/.well-known/agent-skills/tripwire/SKILL.md).
- The /api/ and /data/ paths are for the app itself and are disallowed in robots.txt.
